subject: a deep corridor of physical bare-metal server racks in a massive data center hall
alt_text: A compressed telephoto view of physical bare-metal server racks receding into the hazy distance of a large data center hall.
caption: Repatriating steady workloads to owned physical racks can cut infrastructure costs by half or more.
title: The Bare Metal Break-Even
